parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: the mutable default argument `metadata: dict = {}` is mutated by `metadata.setdefault("content-type", ...)`, so the first call's guessed content type persists in the shared dict and is reused for later uploads without metadata, causing wrong Content-Type. Both also note caller-supplied dicts get mutated. Same root cause, same location, same example-level consequence.
